newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine cuts refinancing rate to 16 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine cuts refinancing rate to 16 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank cut its key refinancing rate to 16 percent from 18 percent effective on Tuesday, the bank's press service said.
A spokesman said the decision was taken in line with recent falls in monthly inflation, which was 0.1 percent in July, the same as in June.
Prices have risen 5.4 percent so far this year, compared to a rise of 25 percent for the same period last year.
The bank cut the refinancing rate early last month to 18 percent from 21 percent. It stood at 105 percent in early 1996.
